# QuartzLock reference

Fictional independent test reference.

QuartzLock.renewLease performs the supported operation. The renewalSeconds field selects its parameter. The holder extends its lease before the ownership deadline expires. QuartzLock uses this operation and field together. ownership lease renewal deadline.

Use QuartzLock.renewLease with renewalSeconds; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
